h1: Custom Large Fleece for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom large fleece for your team or event. Perfect for layering, with decoration options. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When you need custom fleece that fits comfortably over work shirts or uniforms, ordering in size large ensures your team gets a functional layering piece without being restrictive. Large fleece jackets and pullovers offer enough room for easy movement while maintaining a professional silhouette. Whether you choose a quarter-zip for easy branding on the chest or a full-zip jacket for versatile wear, large sizes accommodate embroidery or screen printing on the front and back. Perfect for corporate events, outdoor teams, or safety managers looking for practical cold-weather gear.
heroAltText: Custom large fleece jacket with embroidered logo, featuring a quarter-zip design in navy blue
